stories.title: OpenAI reportedly closing $30B round at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
stories.summary: OpenAI is reportedly closing a $30 billion bridge round at a $1.25 trillion valuation before its IPO, according to October 23 briefings. The reported round comes a week after Anthropic's prospectus reset the bar for AI listings, according to the same briefing.

stories.title: Treasury proposes wider curbs on US investment in China AI
stories.summary: The US Treasury Department proposed rules on October 22 to restrict American investment in artificial intelligence, supercomputing, biotechnology and hypersonic systems in China, Russia, North Korea and other countries of concern. The draft implements legislation passed in December 2025, applies above a $50,000 threshold, and excludes many financial investments including stock purchases. Comments are due December 7.

stories.title: X reportedly plans to let AI agents write Community Notes
stories.summary: X is reportedly planning to use artificial intelligence to write Community Notes, asking developers to submit custom AI agents capable of verifying the authenticity of posts and providing neutral explanations. The move would mark a major shift in the platform's fact-checking programme, which currently relies on human contributors whose notes appear only after consensus from groups that have historically disagreed.

stories.title: Epic Games confirms huge AI-first pivot, CEO says on X
stories.summary: Epic Games has begun a massive pivot toward AI-first development, with CEO Tim Sweeney confirming on X that the company is moving developers around to retool for maximum AI acceleration. According to Bloomberg reporting, the shift applies to an unannounced shooter combining Marvel and Star Wars characters, whose release was delayed. Epic says the aim is not downsizing but letting teams produce more and better work, with creative control remaining with humans.

stories.title: OpenAI's Decisions API is now generally available
stories.summary: OpenAI announced that its Decisions API is now generally available for developers, powered by GPT-6 Luna. It is designed to help AI agents and apps make small, recurring decisions such as categorising information, routing requests and selecting the next action, with near real-time decisions using images, text and structured inputs. OpenAI claims decisions up to 10x faster than via the Responses API, with up to 400 questions per request and native JSON inputs.

stories.title: Canva launches Craft, its first in-house AI image model
stories.summary: Canva has introduced Craft, an image generation model designed to create both realistic images and design-focused visuals. Developed by Canva Research, it uses a two-stage process to plan image composition before rendering the final result, was trained on millions of templates from Canva's content library, and supports editable outputs through Magic Layers. It ranked first in the People and Portraits and Landscapes and Nature categories on DesignArena, with faster Craft-fast and Craft-ultrafast versions in development.
